Use this action when you need to modify an existing web experience profile that controls the checkout flow appearance, branding, shipping options, and customer experience for PayPal payments. This action replaces the entire profile configuration with the provided values. A successful update returns HTTP 204 No Content with no JSON response body. This action is idempotent - updating a profile with the same values produces the same result without side effects.

tools.name: Verify Payment Method via Braintree
tools.description: Verifies a multi-use payment method to ensure it has passed fraud rules and is associated with a valid account. Use this action when you need to verify that a vaulted (multi-use) payment method is valid before using it for transactions. The verification runs the payment method through your configured Braintree fraud rules and confirms with the card issuer that the card is associated with a valid account. This action is commonly used when a customer adds a new payment method and you want to validate it, when checking if a stored payment method is still valid before a scheduled transaction, or as part of a risk management workflow to pre-validate payment methods. The response includes a verification status (VERIFIED, FAILED, GATEWAY_REJECTED, or PROCESSOR_DECLINED) along with processor response codes. Note: This action uses the Braintree GraphQL API endpoint at /graphql. The payment method must be a multi-use token that has been stored in the Braintree vault.

tools.name: Verify Webhook Signature
tools.description: Verifies the signature of a PayPal webhook notification to confirm its authenticity. Use this action when you receive a webhook notification from PayPal and need to verify that it was actually sent by PayPal and not tampered with during transmission. This is essential for security when processing webhook events like payments, disputes, or subscription changes. The required parameters (auth_algo, cert_url, transmission_id, transmission_sig, transmission_time, webhook_id, and webhook_event) are extracted from the webhook notification headers and body that PayPal sends to your endpoint.

tools.name: Add Products to Page
tools.description: Tool to add products to a Paystack payment page. Use when you need to add products to an existing page that was created with 'product' type. This action adds the specified products to the page, allowing customers to select from multiple products when making a payment.

tools.name: Add Products to Storefront
tools.description: Tool to add previously created products to a Storefront. Use when you need to associate existing products with a specific storefront.

tools.name: Add Split Code to Virtual Terminal
tools.description: Tool to add a split code to a virtual terminal. Use when you need to assign payment splitting configuration to a virtual terminal.

tools.name: Add Subaccount to Split
tools.description: Tool to add a subaccount to a split configuration, or update the share of an existing subaccount. Use this when you need to modify the payment distribution by adding new partners/customers to a split or adjusting their allocation. The split must already exist before adding subaccounts to it.

tools.name: Archive Payment Request
tools.description: Tool to archive a payment request to clean up records. Use when you need to remove a payment request from active listings. An archived payment request cannot be verified and will not appear when listing payment requests.

tools.name: Assign Destination to Virtual Terminal
tools.description: Tool to assign WhatsApp destinations to a Virtual Terminal for payment notifications. Use when you need to add recipients who will receive notifications for payments made through a specific Virtual Terminal.

tools.name: Check Pending Charge
tools.description: Tool to check the status of a pending charge transaction. Use when you receive a 'pending' status from a charge endpoint or need to verify if a charge status has changed. Wait at least 10 seconds after initiating a charge before calling this endpoint.

tools.name: Check Slug Availability
tools.description: Tool to check if a custom slug is available for use when creating a payment page. Use when you need to verify a slug is not already taken before creating a new payment page.

tools.name: Bulk Create Transfer Recipients
tools.description: Create multiple transfer recipients in batches. Use when you need to add multiple recipients at once for transfers. Duplicate account numbers automatically return existing recipient records instead of creating duplicates.

tools.name: Create Charge
tools.description: Tool to initiate a payment by integrating the payment channel of your choice. Use when you need to charge a customer using authorization code, bank account, mobile money, or USSD.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Tool to create a customer on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to add a new customer with their email address and optional details like name and phone number.

tools.name: Create Payment Page
tools.description: Tool to create a payment page on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to create a payment page that customers can visit to make payments.

tools.name: Create Payment Request
tools.description: Create a new payment request by issuing an invoice to a customer. Use this when you need to request payment from a customer for goods or services.

tools.name: Create Plan
tools.description: Tool to create a plan for recurring payments on Paystack. Use when you need to set up subscription billing or recurring payment schedules. The plan defines the amount, interval, and other settings for recurring charges to customers.

tools.name: Create Refund
tools.description: Tool to initiate a refund for a previously completed transaction on Paystack. Use when a customer requests a refund or when you need to reverse a payment. The refund can be for the full transaction amount or a partial amount.

tools.name: Create Split Configuration
tools.description: Tool to create a split configuration for transaction revenue sharing. Use when you need to configure how transaction revenue should be split between multiple subaccounts (e.g., for marketplace platforms, revenue sharing, or commission distribution).

tools.name: Create Storefront
tools.description: Create a digital storefront on Paystack to manage and display products. Use this when you need to set up a new online shop for selling digital or physical products.

tools.name: Create Subaccount
tools.description: Tool to create a subaccount on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to set up a new subaccount with bank details and settlement information.

tools.name: Create Transfer Recipient
tools.description: Tool to create a new recipient for transfers. Use when you need to set up a recipient before initiating a transfer. Note: A duplicate account number will lead to retrieval of the existing record rather than creating a new one.

tools.name: Create Virtual Terminal
tools.description: Create a Virtual Terminal on your Paystack integration to accept payments. Use this when you need to set up a new payment terminal for in-person or remote transactions with custom notification settings.

tools.name: Deactivate Authorization
tools.description: Tool to deactivate an authorization when a card or payment method needs to be forgotten. Use when customers want to remove saved payment methods from their account.

tools.name: Deactivate Virtual Terminal
tools.description: Tool to deactivate a Virtual Terminal on your integration. Use when you need to disable a terminal and prevent it from accepting further payments.

tools.name: Delete Product
tools.description: Delete a previously created product from Paystack by its ID. Use this when you need to remove a product from your catalog. The deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Storefront
tools.description: Delete a previously created storefront from Paystack by its ID. Use this when you need to remove a storefront. The deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Transfer Recipient
tools.description: Tool to delete a transfer recipient by setting it to inactive status. Use when you need to remove a recipient from the active transfer list.

tools.name: Disable OTP for Transfers
tools.description: Tool to disable OTP requirement for programmatic transfers. Use when you want to complete transfers without OTP verification. Returns an OTP needed to finalize the request.

tools.name: Disable Subscription
tools.description: Tool to disable a subscription on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to stop recurring charges for a customer subscription. Requires the subscription code and email verification token sent to the customer.

tools.name: Duplicate Storefront
tools.description: Tool to duplicate a previously created Storefront. Use when you need to create a copy of an existing storefront with the same configuration.

tools.name: Enable OTP for Transfers
tools.description: Tool to enable OTP requirement for transfers. Use when a customer wants to stop being able to complete transfers programmatically and require OTP verification instead.

tools.name: Export Transactions
tools.description: Tool to export transactions from Paystack for a specific timeframe. Use when you need to download transaction data for reporting, analysis, or record-keeping purposes. The API returns a download link that expires after a certain time.

tools.name: Fetch Balance
tools.description: Tool to fetch the available balance on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to check account balance across different currencies.

tools.name: Fetch balance ledger
tools.description: Tool to fetch all pay-ins and pay-outs that went into your Paystack balance. Use when you need to view transaction history and balance changes over time.

tools.name: Fetch Bulk Charge Batch
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific bulk charge batch by code. Use when you need to check the progress of a bulk charge batch via its total_charges and pending_charges attributes.

tools.name: Fetch Customer
tools.description: Tool to get details of a customer on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve customer information using their customer code.

tools.name: Fetch Mandate Authorizations
tools.description: Tool to fetch the list of direct debit mandate authorizations associated with a customer. Use when you need to retrieve all mandate authorizations for a specific customer ID.

tools.name: Fetch Payment Page
tools.description: Tool to fetch details of a payment page on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to retrieve information about a specific payment page by its ID.

tools.name: Fetch Payment Request Details
tools.description: Tool to fetch details of a payment request from Paystack. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about a previously created payment request, including customer details, payment status, line items, and associated metadata.

tools.name: Fetch Payment Session Timeout
tools.description: Tool to fetch the payment session timeout configured on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to check the current timeout duration for payment sessions.

tools.name: Fetch Plan
tools.description: Tool to get details of a plan on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve plan information using the plan code or ID.

tools.name: Fetch Product
tools.description: Tool to get details of a product on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve product information by its ID.

tools.name: Fetch Product Orders
tools.description: Tool to fetch all orders for a particular product on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to retrieve order history and details for a specific product by its ID.

tools.name: Fetch Refund
tools.description: Tool to get details of a refund on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about a specific refund, including status, amount, customer details, and timestamps.

tools.name: Fetch Split
tools.description: Tool to get details of a split configuration for a transaction. Use when you need to retrieve split payment configuration information by its ID.

tools.name: Fetch Storefront
tools.description: Tool to get the details of a previously created Storefront. Use when you need to retrieve information about a specific storefront including its products, contacts, and configuration.

tools.name: Fetch Storefront Orders
tools.description: Tool to fetch all orders in a Paystack storefront. Use when you need to retrieve order information for a specific storefront using its ID.

tools.name: Fetch Subaccount
tools.description: Tool to get details of a subaccount on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve subaccount information using the subaccount code.

tools.name: Fetch Subscription
tools.description: Tool to get details of a subscription on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve subscription information using the subscription code.

tools.name: Fetch Transaction
tools.description: Tool to get details of a transaction carried out on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about a specific transaction, including payment status, customer details, authorization info, and timestamps.

tools.name: Fetch Transaction Timeline
tools.description: Tool to fetch the timeline of a transaction showing the steps taken from initiation to completion. Use when you need to debug payment flows or understand where customers encountered issues during the payment process.

tools.name: Fetch Transfer Recipient
tools.description: Tool to fetch details of a transfer recipient. Use when you need to retrieve information about an existing recipient using their recipient code.

tools.name: Fetch Virtual Terminal
tools.description: Tool to fetch a Virtual Terminal on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to retrieve details about an existing virtual terminal, including its configuration, payment methods, and active status.

tools.name: Finalize Payment Request
tools.description: Tool to finalize the creation of a draft payment request for a customer. Use when you need to convert a draft payment request into an active one that can be paid by the customer.

tools.name: Generate Update Subscription Link
tools.description: Tool to generate a link for updating the card on a subscription. Use when you need to allow a customer to update their payment card for an active subscription.

tools.name: Get Payment Request Totals
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metrics for all pending and successful payment requests. Use when you need an overview of payment request amounts grouped by currency and status.

tools.name: Get Transaction Totals
tools.description: Tool to get the total amount received on your Paystack account. Use when you need to retrieve transaction totals and pending transfers, optionally filtered by date range.

tools.name: Initialize Authorization
tools.description: Tool to initialize a reusable authorization for recurring transactions. Use when you need to create a direct debit mandate that allows charging a customer's account repeatedly without requiring them to provide payment details each time.

tools.name: Initialize Transaction
tools.description: Tool to initialize a transaction from your backend. Returns an authorization URL to redirect the customer to for payment. Use when you need to start a payment flow and get a checkout URL for the customer.

tools.name: Initiate Bulk Charge
tools.description: Tool to initiate a bulk charge on your integration. Use when you need to charge multiple customers at once using their authorization codes.

tools.name: List Banks
tools.description: Tool to get a list of all supported banks and their properties on Paystack. Use when you need to retrieve available banks for payments, transfers, or account verification.

tools.name: List Bulk Charge Batches
tools.description: Tool to list bulk charge batches created on your integration. Use when you need to view all bulk charge batches, optionally filtering by status (active, paused, or complete) and paginating through results.

tools.name: List Charges in Batch
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the charges associated with a specified bulk charge batch. Use when you need to inspect individual charge details within a batch to monitor charge statuses or retrieve charge-level information.

tools.name: List countries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of countries that Paystack currently supports. Use when you need to know which countries are available for Paystack operations.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: Tool to list customers available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve all customers with optional filtering by date range and pagination support.

tools.name: List Disputes
tools.description: Tool to list transaction disputes filed by customers on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to retrieve disputes with optional filtering by status, transaction, or date range.

tools.name: List Apple Pay Domains
tools.description: Tool to list all registered Apple Pay domains on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve domains configured for Apple Pay payments.

tools.name: List Mandate Authorizations
tools.description: Tool to get a list of all direct debit mandates on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve mandate authorizations with optional filtering by status and pagination support.

tools.name: List Orders
tools.description: Tool to list orders available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve all orders with optional filtering by date range and pagination support.

tools.name: List Payment Pages
tools.description: Tool to list payment pages available on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to retrieve all payment pages with optional filtering by date range and pagination.

tools.name: List Payment Requests
tools.description: Tool to list all previously created payment requests to your customers. Use when you need to retrieve a list of payment requests with optional filters for customer, status, currency, or date range.

tools.name: List Plans
tools.description: Tool to list all subscription plans available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve plans, optionally filtering by interval, amount, or date range.

tools.name: List Products
tools.description: Tool to list products available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve all products with optional filtering by date range, active status, and pagination support.

tools.name: List Refunds
tools.description: Tool to list refunds available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve a list of refunds with optional filters for date range and pagination.

tools.name: List Settlements
tools.description: Tool to list settlements made to your settlement accounts. Use when you need to retrieve settlement information with optional pagination support.

tools.name: List Splits
tools.description: Tool to list the transaction splits available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve all split configurations with optional filtering by name, status, subaccount, or date range.

tools.name: List states for address verification
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of states for a country for address verification. Use when you need to get available states/provinces for a specific country code.

tools.name: List Storefront Products
tools.description: Tool to list all products in a Paystack storefront. Use when you need to retrieve product information for a specific storefront using its ID.

tools.name: List Storefronts
tools.description: Tool to list storefronts available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve all storefronts with optional filtering by status and pagination support.

tools.name: List Subaccounts
tools.description: Tool to list subaccounts available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve all subaccounts with optional filtering by active status and pagination support.

tools.name: List Subscriptions
tools.description: Tool to list all subscriptions available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve subscriptions, optionally filtering by plan, customer, or date range.

tools.name: List Transactions
tools.description: Tool to list transactions that have occurred on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve all transactions with optional filtering by date range, status, source, channel, customer, and other criteria. Supports both cursor-based and page-based pagination.

tools.name: List Transfer Recipients
tools.description: Tool to list transfer recipients available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve all recipients with optional pagination support.

tools.name: List Transfers
tools.description: Tool to list all transfers carried out on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve transfer history with optional filtering by status, recipient, or date range.

tools.name: List Virtual Terminals
tools.description: Tool to list virtual terminals available on your integration. Use when you need to retrieve all virtual terminals with pagination support.

tools.name: Pause Bulk Charge
tools.description: Tool to pause processing of a bulk charge batch. Use when you need to temporarily stop a bulk charge batch from processing further charges.

tools.name: Publish Storefront
tools.description: Tool to make a Storefront publicly available on Paystack. Use this when you need to publish a previously created storefront so that customers can access and purchase from it.

tools.name: Remove Subaccount from Split
tools.description: Tool to remove a subaccount from a split configuration. Use this when you need to stop payment distribution to a specific partner or customer in an existing split. The share parameter must match the subaccount's current allocation.

tools.name: Resend OTP for Transfer
tools.description: Tool to resend OTP for a transfer. Use when a customer is having trouble receiving their OTP and needs a new one sent to complete their transfer.

tools.name: Resolve Card BIN
tools.description: Tool to get basic information about a card BIN (Bank Identification Number). Use when you need to retrieve card details such as brand, issuing bank, country, and card type from the first 6 digits of a card.

tools.name: Resume Bulk Charge Batch
tools.description: Tool to resume processing of a previously paused bulk charge batch. Use when you need to restart a paused bulk charge batch using its batch code.

tools.name: Send Payment Request Notification
tools.description: Tool to send an email notification to a customer for a previously created payment request. Use when you need to remind a customer about an unpaid invoice or payment request.

tools.name: Send Subscription Update Link
tools.description: Tool to send an email to the customer with a link to update the card on their subscription. Use when a customer needs to update their payment card for an active subscription and you want to notify them via email.

tools.name: Set Risk Action
tools.description: Tool to set a customer's risk action by whitelisting or blacklisting them. Use when you need to apply fraud prevention rules to a specific customer by setting their risk action to 'allow' (whitelist), 'deny' (blacklist), or 'default' (no special action).

tools.name: Submit Phone
tools.description: Tool to submit phone number when requested during a charge transaction. Use this when a charge requires phone number submission for verification or authentication purposes.

tools.name: Trigger direct debit activation charge
tools.description: Tool to trigger an activation charge on an inactive direct debit mandate for a customer. Use when a mandate needs to be reactivated or retried.

tools.name: Unassign Destination from Virtual Terminal
tools.description: Tool to unassign WhatsApp destinations from a Virtual Terminal. Use when you need to remove recipients who should no longer receive payment notifications for a specific Virtual Terminal.

tools.name: Unregister Apple Pay Domain
tools.description: Tool to unregister a top-level domain or subdomain previously used for Apple Pay integration. Use when you need to remove a domain from your Apple Pay configuration.

tools.name: Update Customer

tools.name: Update Payment Page
tools.description: Tool to update a payment page on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to modify details of an existing payment page such as name, description, amount, or active status.

tools.name: Update Payment Request
tools.description: Tool to update a payment request on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to modify details of an existing payment request such as amount, description, due date, or other attributes.

tools.name: Update Payment Session Timeout

tools.name: Update Plan
tools.description: Tool to update a plan's details on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to modify an existing plan's name, amount, interval, or other settings. Only the fields you provide will be updated; other fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Product
tools.description: Tool to update a product on your integration. Use when you need to modify product details like name, description, price, or currency.

tools.name: Update Split Configuration
tools.description: Tool to update a split configuration for transactions. Use when you need to modify split settings such as name, active status, or bearer type.

tools.name: Update Storefront

tools.name: Update Subaccount
tools.description: Tool to update a subaccount's details on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to modify existing subaccount information such as business name, bank details, contact information, or activation status.

tools.name: Update Transfer Recipient

tools.name: Validate Bank Account
tools.description: Tool to validate the authenticity of a customer's bank account before sending money. Use when you need to confirm account details are correct and the account is active and can receive funds.

tools.name: Validate Customer
tools.description: Tool to validate a customer's identity on your Paystack integration. Use when you need to verify customer identification details such as BVN and bank account information. The verification happens asynchronously, and Paystack sends a webhook event when verification is complete.

tools.name: Validate Order
tools.description: Tool to validate a pay for me order on Paystack. Use when you need to verify the details and status of a previously created order using its unique order code.

tools.name: Verify Payment Request
tools.description: Tool to verify the status of a previously created payment request on Paystack. Use when you need to check if a payment request has been paid or to retrieve details about a specific payment request using its request code.

tools.name: Verify Storefront Slug
tools.description: Tool to verify the availability of a slug before using it for a Storefront. Use when you need to check if a slug is available before creating a new storefront.

tools.name: Verify Transaction
tools.description: Tool to confirm the status of a transaction using its reference. Use when you need to verify a payment was successful or check the current state of a transaction after customer completes checkout.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Tool to list all available templates. Use after authentication to retrieve user's templates. Returns template metadata only; populating or rendering a template requires additional tool calls. Verify returned templates include required fields and variants before proceeding.

tools.name: Get Account Balance Info
tools.description: Tool to get account balance info. Use after authenticating to check remaining credits.

tools.name: Generate Barcode (Deprecated)

tools.name: Convert Excel to CSV
tools.description: Tool to convert an Excel file (XLS/XLSX) to CSV. Use when you have a public Excel file URL and need CSV output. Inline option returns data inline; otherwise provides download URL.

tools.name: Convert Excel to HTML
tools.description: Tool to convert an Excel file to HTML. Use when you have an Excel URL and need HTML output.

tools.name: Convert Excel to JSON

tools.name: Convert Excel to Text
tools.description: Tool to convert Excel files to plain text. Use after providing an Excel file URL to extract spreadsheet content.

tools.name: Convert Excel to XML
tools.description: Tool to convert an Excel file to XML. Use when needing XML output from xls/xlsx/csv synchronously or asynchronously.

tools.description: Tool to check status and result of an asynchronous job. Use after submitting a job to poll for completion.

tools.name: Add Content to PDF

tools.name: Upload File from Base64
tools.description: Tool to create a temporary file using base64-encoded source data. Use when you need to upload file content as base64 to PDF.co for downstream processing. Temporary files are automatically deleted after 1 hour (or custom expiration time).

tools.name: Delete PDF Pages

tools.name: Extract PDF Attachments
tools.description: Tool to extract embedded attachments from a PDF. Use when you need to retrieve embedded files from a PDF after uploading.

tools.name: Find Text in PDF

tools.name: PDF Forms Info Reader
tools.description: Tool to extract form field information from a PDF. Use when you need to retrieve names, types, and values of form fields. Returns field names, types (CheckBox, EditBox, RadioButton, ComboBox), values, and position coordinates.

tools.name: Convert Text to PDF
tools.description: Tool to convert a plain text (.txt) file to PDF. Use when you have a public URL to a text file; raw inline text is not accepted by the endpoint.

tools.name: Convert Email to PDF
tools.description: Tool to convert email files (.eml/.msg) to PDF. Use when you need to transform standalone email messages into PDF documents.

tools.name: Convert HTML to PDF
tools.description: Tool to convert HTML code or webpage URL into a PDF document. Use when you need to capture a webpage or HTML snippet as a PDF file.

tools.name: PDF Info Reader
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information and metadata of a PDF. Use when you need page count, author, encryption details, and other document properties.

tools.name: Merge PDFs
tools.description: Tool to merge multiple PDF files into one document. Use when you need to combine several PDF URLs into a single PDF file.

tools.name: Rotate PDF Pages
tools.description: Tool to rotate selected pages in a PDF. Use when you need to adjust the orientation of specific pages in an online PDF file before further processing.

tools.name: Search and Delete Text in PDF
tools.description: Tool to search for and delete text in a PDF by keyword or regex. Use when you need to remove sensitive or unwanted text from a PDF document.

tools.name: Search and Replace Text in PDF
tools.description: Tool to search for and replace text in a PDF document. Use when you need to update specific text instances within an existing PDF file (e.g., changing invoice numbers).

tools.name: Split PDF
tools.description: Tool to split a PDF into multiple files by page ranges. Use when you need to extract specific pages or page ranges from a PDF.

tools.name: Convert PDF to CSV
tools.description: Tool to convert PDF or scanned images to CSV format. Use when you need to extract tabular data from a PDF into CSV format.

tools.name: Convert PDF to HTML
tools.description: Tool to convert PDF documents to HTML. Use when you need an HTML rendition of a PDF or scanned image.

tools.name: Convert PDF to Image
tools.description: Tool to convert PDF pages to images (PNG, JPG, TIFF). Use when you need image previews of PDF content.

tools.name: Convert PDF to JSON
tools.description: Tool to convert PDF or scanned images to JSON format. Use when you need a structured JSON representation of PDF content.

tools.name: Convert PDF to Text
tools.description: Tool to convert PDF or scanned images to plain text. Use when you need raw text output preserving layout.

tools.name: Convert PDF to XLS
tools.description: Tool to convert PDF or scanned images to XLS format. Use when you need to extract tabular data into an Excel spreadsheet.

tools.name: Convert PDF to XLSX
tools.description: Tool to convert PDF or scanned images to XLSX (Excel) format. Use when you need structured spreadsheet output from a PDF.

tools.name: Convert PDF to XML
tools.description: Tool to convert PDF or scanned images to XML format. Use when you need to extract structured data from PDF into XML.

tools.name: Convert to PDF
tools.description: Tool to convert various document and image formats to PDF. Handles one file per call; multi-file PDFs require multiple calls followed by a separate merge step. Conversion permanently removes interactive form field editability — retain the original file as backup, and ensure all form fields are populated before converting. Use when you need to transform base64-encoded files into PDFs before further processing.

tools.name: Extract Text from PDF
tools.description: Tool to extract embedded text from text-based PDFs using PDF4me's ExtractResources endpoint. Use when you need to retrieve searchable text content from PDFs for analysis or processing. This tool does not perform OCR; for scanned or image-only PDFs, use OCR endpoints instead.

tools.name: Fill PDF Form
tools.description: Tool to fill PDF form fields programmatically using JSON or XML data. Use when you need to generate reports or populate forms from various data sources with mail merge functionality. Supports filling multiple documents from a list of data collection items.

tools.name: Read Barcodes from Image
tools.description: Tool to read and extract barcode or QR code data from image files (JPG/PNG). Use when you need to decode barcodes from images for data extraction or verification. Supports various barcode types including QR codes, Code128, DataMatrix, and more.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: Create a reusable HTML template for later PDF generation.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Permanently delete one saved template owned by the connected account.

tools.name: Generate PDF
tools.description: Generate a PDF from exactly one saved template, HTML document, Markdown document, or AI prompt and return a temporary download URL.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Return the connected PDFgen account, organization, plan, and current credit usage.

tools.name: Get Template
tools.description: Get one saved PDFgen template, including its complete HTML content.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: List saved PDF templates owned by the connected account and return one page with a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Usage Logs
tools.description: List recent PDFgen API calls for auditing, billing inspection, and generation troubleshooting. Returns one page with a continuation cursor. Usage logs are eventually consistent, so a just-completed call may be absent; retry after a short delay before concluding that it was not recorded.

tools.name: Update Template
tools.description: Partially update a saved template's name, HTML content, or rendering engine without replacing omitted fields.

tools.name: Get Workspace
tools.description: Get workspace details and information. Use this to check if a workspace exists or is available based on the API key. Retrieves metadata about the current workspace including its active status, creation date, and name.

tools.name: List Document Templates
tools.description: List all document templates in your PDFLess workspace with pagination support. Use this action to discover available templates before generating PDFs. Templates must be created in the PDFLess dashboard before they appear in this list. The response includes template IDs which are required for PDF generation operations.

tools.name: Create Document
tools.description: Tool to create a Document. Use when you need to instantiate a PDF from a template; set status='pending' to queue immediate generation. Ensure valid `document_template_id` is provided.

tools.name: Create Document Sync
tools.description: Tool to create a document and wait for generation to finish. Use when immediate PDF is needed.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: Creates a new PDF document template in PDFMonkey. Use this to define reusable templates with HTML/Liquid content and CSS styles for generating PDF documents. Typical workflow: Create template → Preview with draft content → Publish → Generate documents. The template supports Liquid templating syntax (e.g., {{variable_name}}) for dynamic content injection. Only 'identifier' is required; all other fields have sensible defaults.

tools.name: Delete Document
tools.description: Tool to delete a Document by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a document after confirming its ID. Returns 204 No Content on success.

tools.name: Delete PDFMonkey Document Template
tools.description: Tool to delete a document template by ID. Use when you need to remove obsolete templates after validation.

tools.name: Download Document File
tools.description: Tool to download a generated PDF file via a presigned URL. Use after obtaining a valid download_url from the Document details endpoint. Verify document status is 'success' (not 'draft' or 'pending') via PDFMONKEY_GET_DOCUMENT before downloading to avoid incomplete files. The URL expires after 1 hour; fetch a new URL upon expiry (403 Forbidden).

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details about the currently authenticated user. Use when you need account info (quota, plan, email, locale) after authentication.

tools.name: Get Document
tools.description: Tool to fetch a Document by its ID. Returns the full document record including payload, meta, logs, and download URL. Note: download_url is time-limited; if a download attempt fails, call GetDocument again to obtain a fresh URL. Check the status field for a finalized (non-draft) state before passing the record to downstream processing tools.

tools.name: Get DocumentCard
tools.description: Tool to fetch a DocumentCard by ID. Use when you have a DocumentCard ID and need its download URLs, status, and metadata. Use after generating or updating a DocumentCard.

tools.name: Get Template by ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch a Document Template by ID. Use when you need the template's content, styles, settings, and preview URL.

tools.name: List DocumentCards
tools.description: Tool to list DocumentCards. Use when you need to retrieve multiple DocumentCards with optional pagination and filtering by template, status, workspace, or update time.

tools.name: List PDF Engines
tools.description: Lists all available PDF rendering engines in PDFMonkey. Returns engine IDs, version names, numeric versions, and deprecation status. Use this to select a PDF engine when creating templates or generating documents. Recommended: Use the latest non-deprecated engine (e.g., v5 or highest version).

tools.name: List Template Cards
tools.description: List all document template cards for a workspace. Use this action to: - Retrieve all templates available in a workspace - Filter templates by folder (or get only root folder templates with folders='none') - Paginate through large template lists - Sort templates by identifier, creation date, or last update date Returns template cards with metadata including IDs, names, auth tokens, and timestamps.

tools.name: List Workspaces
tools.description: Tool to list workspaces (applications). Use when you need all available workspaces for the authenticated user after login.

tools.name: Preview Template
tools.description: Fetches the template preview viewer page from PDFMonkey's preview_url. Returns an HTML viewer page that displays the rendered template draft. Use this after obtaining a template's preview_url via Get Template or List Templates.

tools.name: Update Document
tools.description: Updates an existing PDFMonkey document's payload, metadata, template, or status. Common use cases: - Modify document data (payload) before generation - Change the template used for the document - Add or update custom metadata - Trigger PDF regeneration by setting status to 'pending' Note: To regenerate a document with updated data, update the payload and set status='pending'.

tools.name: Update Document Template
tools.description: Tool to update a document template’s properties. Use when you need to modify an existing template’s content, styles, settings, engine, folder, or TTL.

tools.name: View Public Share Link
tools.description: Tool to download a publicly shared PDF via its permanent share link. Use when the document's public_share_link is enabled to fetch the PDF file directly.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create a project in a Peaka workspace and return its project ID and available project details for use with Peaka data and query tools.

tools.name: Create Workspace
tools.description: Create a workspace in an organization and return its workspace ID and details.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Permanently delete a project and its project-scoped data from a Peaka workspace.

tools.name: Delete Workspace
tools.description: Permanently delete a workspace. Projects and other contents within it may become unavailable.

tools.name: Execute Query
tools.description: Execute one read-only SQL SELECT or CTE ending in LIMIT 1-1000 in a Peaka project and return rows in SIMPLE object format.

tools.name: List Data Resources
tools.description: Browse a project's catalogs, schemas, tables, or columns to discover qualified resources for SQL queries.

tools.name: List Hierarchy
tools.description: List organizations, workspaces in an organization, or projects in a workspace, returning the IDs needed for hierarchy administration.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Replace the name and optional description of a project in its current workspace.

tools.name: Update Workspace
tools.description: Replace the name and optional description of an existing workspace.

tools.name: Create Custom Field Definition
tools.description: Create one custom-field definition that controls a named field's owner, type, multiplicity, order, and visibility.

tools.name: Create Group
tools.description: Create a group from an existing parent-group anchor on a map. Set external to true to detach the new group as a top-level external group.

tools.name: Create Peer
tools.description: Create an email-free person record in the organization; this tool deliberately cannot provision a Peerdom login account.

tools.name: Create Role
tools.description: Create a role under a parent group on a map using core role fields that do not require Peerdom's Contribution or Goals apps.

tools.name: Deactivate Peer
tools.description: Mark a peer as former. This is a soft delete: the peer is removed from normal active-peer reads but remains available when former peers are included.

tools.name: Delete Custom Field Definition
tools.description: Permanently delete a custom-field definition. WARNING: Peerdom cascade-deletes every value stored against the definition; this cannot be undone and requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Delete Group
tools.description: Permanently delete one group after reading it to block accidental root-group deletion. Root deletion requires separate explicit authorization.

tools.name: Delete Role
tools.description: Delete one role by ID and return the deleted role for confirmation.

tools.name: Get Custom Field Definitions
tools.description: List custom-field definitions or return one definition by ID so agents can use the organization's real field names and value types.

tools.name: Get Groups
tools.description: List organization groups or return one group by ID, with optional map and peer filters and optional custom-field-value expansion.

tools.name: Get Organization Context
tools.description: Return the connected Peerdom organization and its maps, including the live map ID and tenant palette needed to create groups and roles.

tools.name: Get Peers
tools.description: List peers with optional former-peer and custom-field inclusion, or return one peer by ID with optional roles and custom fields.

tools.name: Get Roles
tools.description: List roles or return one role by ID, with optional peer, group, and map filters plus holder, group, representing-node, and custom-field expansions.

tools.name: Unassign Role Holder
tools.description: Remove one peer's assignment from one role without deleting either the peer or the role.

tools.name: Update Custom Field Definition
tools.description: Rename a custom-field definition and its custom-field API key, or update its labels, display order, or public visibility without changing its value type or owner.

tools.name: Update Group
tools.description: Update selected group properties such as name, parent, external state, color, shape, or custom fields. Omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Peer
tools.description: Update selected profile fields on an existing peer; omitted fields remain unchanged despite the provider using PUT.

tools.name: Update Role
tools.description: Update selected core role properties without changing Contribution- or Goals-specific settings.

tools.name: Assign Or Update Role Holder
tools.description: Ensure a peer holds a role, creating the assignment when absent or updating its percentage, focus, and elected-until date when present.

tools.name: Create Access Token
tools.description: Tool to create a personal access token for API authentication in Penpot. Use when you need to generate a new token for authenticating API requests. The token will only be shown once during creation, so it should be stored securely.

tools.name: Create Comment Thread
tools.description: Tool to create a new comment thread on a Penpot file at a specific position. Use when you need to add collaborative feedback or discussion points on design elements within a Penpot project.

tools.name: Create File
tools.description: Tool to create a new design file in a Penpot project. Use when you need to create a new file for design work within a specific project.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Tool to create a new project within a team in Penpot. Use when you need to organize design files into a new project space.

tools.name: Create Team
tools.description: Tool to create a new team in Penpot. Use when you need to set up a new team for organizing projects and collaborating with team members.

tools.name: Create Team Access Request
tools.description: Tool to request an invitation to join a Penpot team. Use when a user needs to request access to a team for collaboration.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook for a team to receive event notifications. Use when you need to register a new webhook endpoint that will be notified of events happening in a Penpot team.

tools.name: Delete Access Token
tools.description: Tool to delete a personal access token from Penpot. Use when you need to revoke or remove an existing access token by its UUID.

tools.name: Delete Comment
tools.description: Tool to delete a comment from a Penpot design file. Use when you need to permanently remove a specific comment from a design discussion.

tools.name: Delete File Snapshot
tools.description: Tool to delete a file snapshot in Penpot. Use when you need to remove a previously created snapshot from a file.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Tool to delete a project from Penpot. Use when you need to permanently remove a project and all its contents.

tools.name: Delete Team
tools.description: Tool to delete a team from Penpot. Use when you need to permanently remove a team. This operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Permanently Delete Team Files
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete specified files from a Penpot team. Use when you need to immediately and irreversibly remove files from a team. The team ID is used to filter files and verify write permissions.

tools.name: Delete Team Invitation
tools.description: Tool to delete a pending team invitation in Penpot. Use when you need to cancel an invitation that hasn't been accepted yet.

tools.name: Delete Team Member
tools.description: Tool to remove a member from a team in Penpot. Use when you need to revoke a user's access to a team.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook by its UUID. Use when you need to remove a webhook from Penpot.

tools.name: Duplicate File
tools.description: Tool to duplicate a single file within the same team in Penpot. Use when you need to create a copy of an existing design file.

tools.name: Duplicate Project
tools.description: Tool to duplicate an entire Penpot project with all its files. Use when you need to create a copy of an existing project.

tools.name: Get Access Tokens
tools.description: Tool to list all personal access tokens for the authenticated user. Use when you need to view, audit, or manage existing access tokens.

tools.name: Get All Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all projects across all teams in Penpot. Use when you need a complete list of projects regardless of team membership.

tools.name: Get Builtin Templates
tools.description: Tool to get the list of builtin templates available in Penpot. Use when you need to see which templates are available for creating new projects.

tools.name: Get Comments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all comments in a comment thread. Use when you need to fetch all comments from a specific thread.

tools.name: Get Comment Thread
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific comment thread from a Penpot file. Use when you need to fetch details about a comment thread including its comments, participants, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Comment Threads
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all comment threads for a Penpot file. Use when you need to fetch comments and discussions associated with a specific file.

tools.name: Get File
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a Penpot file by its ID. Returns file details including metadata, structure, and permissions. Use when you need to access file information or check file properties.

tools.name: Get File Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve basic information about a Penpot file by its ID. Use when you need to get file metadata such as name, project, creation date, modification date, version, and sharing status.

tools.name: Get File Libraries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve libraries linked to a Penpot file. Use when you need to get all library references associated with a specific file by its UUID.

tools.name: Get File Object Thumbnails
tools.description: Tool to retrieve thumbnails for objects in a Penpot file. Use when you need to get thumbnail URLs for file objects.

tools.name: Get File Snapshots
tools.description: Retrieves all snapshots for a specific Penpot file. Use this action to list all saved versions (snapshots) of a file, which allows viewing version history and understanding how the file has evolved over time. Snapshots capture the state of a file at specific points in time.

tools.name: Get File Summary
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a summary of file contents and statistics from Penpot. Use when you need high-level information about a file including page count, components, graphics, and other metadata without fetching the entire file content.

tools.name: Get Font Variants
tools.description: Tool to retrieve font variants for a team, file, project, or share in Penpot. Use when you need to get a list of available font variants. Provide at least one of team_id, file_id, project_id, or share_id to scope the query.

tools.name: Get Library File References
tools.description: Tool to get files that reference a shared library. Use when you need to find which files are using a specific library file in Penpot.

tools.name: Get Library Usage
tools.description: Tool to get usage statistics for a library. Returns the number of files that use the specified library. Use when you need to understand how widely a library is being used across projects.

tools.name: Get Owned Teams
tools.description: Tool to list teams owned by the current user. Use when you need to retrieve teams that the authenticated user owns in Penpot.

tools.name: Get Page
tools.description: Tool to retrieve page data from a Penpot file. Use when you need to get page content including objects and metadata for rendering or export purposes. If no page ID is specified, returns the first page. Can filter to a specific object and its children by providing an object ID.

tools.name: Get Profiles for File Comments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve profiles of users who have commented on a Penpot file. Use when you need to get information about comment participants for collaboration or user management purposes.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific Penpot project by its ID. Use when you need to get project details such as name, team ownership, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Project Files
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all files in a Penpot project. Use when you need to list all files for a specific project by its UUID.

tools.name: Get SSO Provider
tools.description: Tool to retrieve SSO provider information for an email address. Use when you need to determine which SSO provider is configured for a specific email domain.

tools.name: Get Subscription Usage
tools.description: Tool to get subscription usage information for the current user. Returns details about seats and storage usage. Use when you need to check subscription limits or current usage statistics.

tools.name: Get Team
tools.description: Tool to retrieve team details by ID. Use when you need to fetch information about a specific team in Penpot.

tools.name: Get Team Deleted Files
tools.description: Tool to retrieve deleted files from a team's trash in Penpot. Use when you need to view files that have been deleted from a specific team and are in the trash.

tools.name: Get Team Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific Penpot team by its ID. Use when you need to get team details such as name, creation date, and permissions.

tools.name: Get Team Invitations
tools.description: Tool to list pending invitations for a team in Penpot. Use when you need to retrieve all pending team invitations that haven't been accepted yet.

tools.name: Get Team Members
tools.description: Tool to list all members of a team in Penpot. Use when you need to retrieve team membership information and member details.

tools.name: Get Teams
tools.description: Tool to list all teams the authenticated user is a member of. Use when you need to retrieve teams where the user has membership in Penpot.

tools.name: Get Team Shared Files
tools.description: Tool to retrieve shared library files for a Penpot team. Use when you need to list all shared library files for a specific team by its UUID.

tools.name: Get Team Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve statistics for a specific Penpot team by its ID. Use when you need to get team metrics such as project count, file count, and member count.

tools.name: Get Team Users
tools.description: Tool to retrieve users in a team by team ID or file ID. Use when you need to list team members associated with a specific team or file.

tools.name: Get Unread Comment Threads
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comment threads with unread comments for a specific team. Use when you need to check for new comments or discussions requiring attention.

tools.name: Get View Only Bundle
tools.description: Tool to retrieve data bundle for view-only file access in Penpot. Use when you need to access read-only file data through a share link or for preview purposes.

tools.name: Get Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all webhooks configured for a team. Use when you need to list existing webhook endpoints registered for a Penpot team.

tools.name: Has File Libraries
tools.description: Tool to check if a Penpot file has linked libraries. Use when you need to determine whether a specific file references any external libraries.

tools.name: Ignore File Library Sync Status
tools.description: Tool to ignore library sync status updates for a file. Use when you need to mark library updates as ignored for a specific file, preventing sync notifications from appearing.

tools.name: Link File to Library
tools.description: Tool to link a file to a library in Penpot. Returns the recursive list of libraries used by that library. Use when you need to establish a library reference relationship between a file and a library.

tools.name: Lock File Snapshot
tools.description: Tool to lock a file snapshot in Penpot to prevent deletion. Use when you need to protect a snapshot from being removed.

tools.name: Logout
tools.description: Tool to clear the authentication cookie and logout the current session. Use when the authenticated user wants to end their Penpot session and invalidate their authentication.

tools.name: Mark All Threads As Read
tools.description: Tool to mark all comment threads as read in Penpot. Use when you need to clear unread status for comment threads.

tools.name: Move Files
tools.description: Tool to move files from one project to another in Penpot. Use when you need to reorganize files by transferring them between projects.

tools.name: Move Project
tools.description: Tool to move a project to a different team in Penpot. Use when you need to transfer a project from one team to another.

tools.name: Prepare Register Profile
tools.description: Tool to prepare user registration by validating email and sending verification in Penpot. Use when you need to initiate the registration process for a new user. This endpoint validates the provided information and typically sends a verification email to complete the registration.

tools.name: Push Audit Events
tools.description: Tool to push audit events to Penpot for tracking system behavior and user actions. Use when you need to log important events like user actions, file changes, or team modifications for auditing purposes.

tools.name: Register Profile
tools.description: Tool to complete user registration with profile details using a verification token. Use when you have a registration token from the prepare-register-profile endpoint and need to finalize the user account creation.

tools.name: Rename File
tools.description: Tool to rename a design file in Penpot. Use when you need to change the name of an existing file.

tools.name: Rename Project
tools.description: Tool to rename an existing project in Penpot. Use when you need to update a project's name.

tools.name: Request Profile Recovery
tools.description: Tool to request a password/profile recovery email. Use when a user has forgotten their password and needs to initiate the account recovery process. An email with a recovery token will be sent to the specified address.

tools.name: Restore Deleted Team Files
tools.description: Tool to restore deleted files in a Penpot team. Use when you need to remove the deletion mark from files and projects that are in the team's trash.

tools.name: Restore File Snapshot
tools.description: Tool to restore a Penpot file to a previous snapshot. Use when you need to revert a file to a previously saved version from its history.

tools.name: Search Files
tools.description: Tool to search for files by name or content in a Penpot team. Use when you need to find specific files within a team using a search term.

tools.name: Send User Feedback
tools.description: Tool to send user feedback to Penpot. Use when you need to submit feedback, bug reports, feature requests, or error reports to the Penpot team.

tools.name: Set File Shared
tools.description: Tool to set file sharing status in Penpot (enable/disable shared library). Use when you need to make a file available as a shared library or revoke its shared status.

tools.name: Unlink File from Library
tools.description: Tool to unlink a file from a shared library in Penpot. Use when you need to remove the library reference relationship between a file and a library.

tools.name: Unlock File Snapshot
tools.description: Tool to unlock a locked file snapshot in Penpot. Use when you need to unlock a previously locked snapshot.

tools.name: Update Comment
tools.description: Tool to update the content of an existing comment in a Penpot design file. Use when you need to modify comment text or update mentioned users in a design discussion.

tools.name: Update Comment Thread
tools.description: Tool to update the resolution status of a comment thread in Penpot. Use when you need to mark a comment thread as resolved or unresolved to track discussion progress.

tools.name: Update Comment Thread Frame
tools.description: Tool to update the frame associated with a comment thread in Penpot. Use when you need to move a comment thread to a different frame or reposition it within the design hierarchy.

tools.name: Update Comment Thread Position
tools.description: Tool to update the position of a comment thread in Penpot. Use when you need to move or reposition an existing comment thread to a different location on the design canvas.

tools.name: Update Comment Thread Status
tools.description: Tool to update the status of a comment thread in Penpot (e.g., toggle resolved/unresolved). Use when you need to mark a comment thread as resolved or reopen a resolved thread.

tools.name: Update File
tools.description: Tool to update a Penpot file with changes. Use when you need to apply modifications to a file such as adding/modifying/deleting objects, pages, colors, components, or other design elements. Requires file ID, session ID, revision number, and version number for optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update File Library Sync Status
tools.description: Tool to update the synchronization status of a file->library link. Use when you need to refresh or update the sync status between a file and its linked library.

tools.name: Update File Snapshot
tools.description: Tool to update a file snapshot metadata in Penpot. Use when you need to modify the label of an existing snapshot.

tools.name: Update Font
tools.description: Tool to update a font's metadata in Penpot. Use when you need to modify the name or other properties of an existing font in a team.

tools.name: Update Profile
tools.description: Tool to update the current authenticated user's profile information. Use when you need to change the user's full name, language preference, or theme settings.

tools.name: Update Profile Notifications
tools.description: Tool to update notification settings for the authenticated user's profile. Use when you need to configure how the user receives notifications about comments and invitations.

tools.name: Update Profile Props
tools.description: Tool to update custom properties for the authenticated user's profile. Use when you need to modify user preferences such as onboarding status, notification settings, newsletter subscriptions, or plugin configurations.

tools.name: Update Project Pin
tools.description: Tool to update the pin status of a project in Penpot. Use when you need to pin or unpin a project for quick access.

tools.name: Update Team
tools.description: Tool to update team settings in Penpot. Use when you need to modify team name or other team properties.

tools.name: Update Team Invitation Role
tools.description: Tool to update the role of a pending team invitation in Penpot. Use when you need to change the role of an invitation that hasn't been accepted yet.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Tool to update an existing webhook configuration. Use when you need to modify the URI, MIME type, or active status of a webhook.

tools.name: Verify Token
tools.description: Tool to verify an authentication or registration token in Penpot. Use when you need to validate a token received from registration, email verification, or other authentication flows.

tools.name: Get News Articles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of news articles based on filters. Use when keywords, sources, or date ranges are specified.

tools.name: Get Companies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information on companies in Perigon’s entity database. Use when you need a full list of companies. Use after confirming a valid API key is present.

tools.name: Get Journalists
tools.description: Tool to retrieve journalist profiles including title, Twitter handle, bio, and location. Use when you need detailed journalist info to enrich content with author metadata.

tools.name: Get Media Sources
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of media sources with filtering options. Use when you need to list sources by domain, country, category, or traffic metrics.

tools.name: Get Stories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve clusters of related articles covering the same event or topic with aggregate metrics. Use when you need to fetch filtered and sorted story clusters after configuring query parameters.

tools.name: Get Topics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available Perigon news topics. Returns a list of topics that can be used to filter articles or stories. Each topic includes an ID, name, and labels (category/subcategory).

tools.name: Get Wikipedia Articles
tools.description: Tool to search and filter Wikipedia pages. Use when you have a search query ready and want to retrieve relevant Wikipedia articles.

tools.name: Vector Search Articles
tools.description: Tool to perform a vector search on Perigon’s real-time news database. Use when you need to retrieve semantically similar news articles given a natural language query.

tools.name: Vector Search Wikipedia
tools.description: Tool to perform semantic retrieval of Wikipedia pages using vector search. Use after obtaining a search query to find relevant Wikipedia articles.

tools.name: Add Lead To Campaign
tools.description: Tool to add a lead to a specified campaign. Use when you have lead details and a campaign ID to enroll the lead into the campaign.

tools.name: Create Campaign

tools.name: Create PDF
