tools.name: Get Template
tools.description: Get a Picnie template's complete layout and simplified dynamic fields for constructing generation replacements.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List all projects belonging to the connected Picnie account, including IDs needed by generation and processing tools.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: List templates available to the connected Picnie account so an agent can select inputs for image or PDF generation.

tools.name: Remove Image Background
tools.description: Use Picnie AI to remove the background from a public image URL. This operation may consume Picnie credits.

tools.name: Resize Image
tools.description: Resize a public image URL either to explicit pixel dimensions or by percentage. This operation may consume Picnie credits.

tools.name: Transcribe Image
tools.description: Extract text from a public image URL with Picnie OCR. This operation may consume Picnie credits; Picnie currently documents only Original for method and language.

tools.name: Upload Asset
tools.description: Upload an image file to the connected Picnie account's persistent media library and return its public URL. Supported formats, size limits, and deletion behavior are not documented.

tools.name: Auchan Product
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed Auchan product information. Use when you have an Auchan product URL.

tools.name: Auchan Product Search
tools.description: Tool to search for products on Auchan by query or search URL. Use when you need product listings and details from Auchan.

tools.name: Piloterr Get Product Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed product information from G2. Use when you need full product details including ratings, reviews, pricing, and company info. Accepts a product name or G2 URL as query.

tools.name: List Chewy Products
tools.description: Tool to find Chewy product categories by search query. Use when you need to retrieve Chewy product URLs and details based on product ID or title.

tools.name: List E.Leclerc Stores
tools.description: Tool to find E.Leclerc store locations by search query. Use when you need to locate E.Leclerc stores in a specific area or city.

tools.name: List Google Countries
tools.description: Tool to list available Google search countries. Use when you need to find country codes for Google search localization.

tools.name: List Google Languages
tools.description: Tool to list available Google search languages filtered by query. Use when you need to find specific language codes for Google searches.

tools.name: List Google Locations
tools.description: Tool to list available Google search locations via Piloterr API. Use when you need to find location identifiers for geographically-targeted searches.

tools.name: List Leroy Merlin Products
tools.description: Tool to list Leroy Merlin product categories. Use when you need to search for Leroy Merlin products by name or identifier.

tools.name: List LinkedIn Industries
tools.description: Tool to list LinkedIn industry codes from Piloterr API. Use when you need to find LinkedIn industry identifiers for targeting or classification.

tools.name: Piloterr Google Search
tools.description: Tool to perform Google web search via Piloterr API. Use when you need to search the web for information using Google.

tools.name: Get Usage
tools.description: Tool to get usage information and remaining credits for your Piloterr account. Use when you need to check account usage and credit details.

tools.name: Check Active Campaigns
tools.description: Tool to check for active campaigns. Use when you need to verify whether any campaigns are currently active.

tools.name: Get User Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the authenticated user. Use when you need to fetch the current user's profile after authentication.

tools.name: List billing accounts
tools.description: Tool to list billing accounts. Use when you need to fetch all billing accounts for management or reporting. Use after authenticating your Pilvio API key.

tools.name: List Credit Cards
tools.description: Tool to list credit cards attached to a billing account. Use after confirming the billing account ID. Example: "Retrieve cards for billing_account_id 'ba_1234567890abcdef'."

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of invoices. Use after authentication to fetch and filter invoices for a billing account.

tools.name: List Pilvio data center locations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available data center locations. Use after authentication to see where you can deploy resources.

tools.name: List VM Resource Pools
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available VM resource pools. Use after authentication to determine where you can provision VMs.

tools.name: List Virtual Machines
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all virtual machines. Use after authenticating to fetch your VMs.

tools.name: List VM Snapshots
tools.description: Tool to list snapshots (replicas) of a specific VM. Use this to get all point-in-time snapshots or backups for a virtual machine.

tools.name: Update User Profile
tools.description: Tool to update the authenticated user's profile. Use after obtaining a valid API key when you need to modify profile details (e.g., change email or name).

tools.name: Create Public Group
tools.description: Create a group for organizing files on the connected account's public IPFS network. The connected Pinata JWT must include org:groups:write.

tools.name: Create Signed Public Upload URL
tools.description: Create a 60-second signed URL for one size- and MIME-constrained public IPFS upload. The URL is a secret: use it immediately and never log or persist it. This action does not upload content itself. The connected Pinata JWT must include org:files:write.

tools.name: Delete Public Group
tools.description: Permanently delete one public-network group by ID. This destructive action does not delete the files the group organized. The connected Pinata JWT must include org:groups:write.

tools.name: Get Public Group
tools.description: Return one public-network group by its Pinata group ID. The connected Pinata JWT must include org:groups:read.

tools.name: List Gateways
tools.description: Return one page of gateways owned by the connected Pinata account without changing gateway configuration. The connected Pinata JWT must include org:gateways:read.

tools.name: List Public Files
tools.description: Return one page of files on the connected account's public IPFS network, optionally filtered by file attributes. The connected Pinata JWT must include org:files:read.

tools.name: List Public Groups
tools.description: Return one page of groups that organize files on the connected account's public IPFS network. The connected Pinata JWT must include org:groups:read.

tools.name: List Upload Metadata
tools.description: List upload-service records, including upload IDs, filenames, CIDs, sizes, group IDs, and timestamps. Use List Public Files instead to search the public IPFS file inventory.

tools.name: Update Public Group
tools.description: Update the name, visibility flag, or both for one public-network group. The connected Pinata JWT must include org:groups:write.

tools.name: Cancel Bulk Import
tools.description: Tool to cancel a bulk import operation in Pinecone. Use when you need to stop an ongoing import operation that is not yet finished.

tools.name: Chat with Assistant
tools.description: Tool to chat with a Pinecone assistant and get structured responses with citations. Use when you need to query an assistant that has access to your knowledge base and want to get back answers with document references and citations.

tools.name: Chat with Assistant
tools.description: Tool to chat with a Pinecone assistant through an OpenAI-compatible interface. Use when you need to interact with a Pinecone assistant that has access to indexed documents and can answer questions based on retrieved context.

tools.name: Configure Index
tools.description: Tool to configure an existing Pinecone index, including pod type, replicas, deletion protection, and tags. Use when you need to scale an index vertically or horizontally, enable/disable deletion protection, or update tags. The change is asynchronous; check index status for completion.

tools.name: Create Assistant
tools.description: Tool to create a new Pinecone assistant for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) applications. Use when you need to initialize a new assistant that can have files uploaded and support chat interactions.

tools.name: Create Backup
tools.description: Tool to create a backup of a Pinecone index for disaster recovery and version control. Use when you need to preserve the current state of an index including vectors, metadata, and configuration.

tools.name: Create Index
tools.description: Tool to create a Pinecone index with specified configuration. Use when you need to initialize a new vector database index for storing and querying embeddings.

tools.name: Create Index with Embedding Model
tools.description: Tool to create a Pinecone index with integrated embedding model for automatic vectorization. Use when you need to set up a new index that automatically converts text to vectors using a pre-configured embedding model.

tools.name: Create Index from Backup
tools.description: Tool to create an index from a backup. Use when you need to restore or duplicate index data from a previously saved backup.

tools.name: Create Namespace
tools.description: Tool to create a namespace within a serverless Pinecone index. Use when you need to organize vectors into isolated partitions.

tools.name: Delete Assistant
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Pinecone assistant. Use when you need to remove an assistant from your project.

tools.name: Delete Backup
tools.description: Tool to delete a backup. Use when you need to permanently remove a backup from your project.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Tool to delete an uploaded file from a Pinecone assistant. Use when you need to remove a file that was previously uploaded to an assistant.

tools.name: Delete Index
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Pinecone index. Use when you need to remove an index from your project. Note: Deletion protection and pending collections can prevent deletion.

tools.name: Delete Namespace
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a namespace from a serverless index. Use when you need to remove an entire namespace and all its data. This operation is irreversible and only supported on serverless indexes.

tools.name: Delete Vectors
tools.description: Tool to delete vectors by ID from a Pinecone index. Use when you need to remove specific vectors from a namespace. Supports deletion by IDs, metadata filter, or entire namespace deletion.

tools.name: Describe Backup
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific backup. Use when you need to check backup status, configuration, or metadata.

tools.name: Describe Bulk Import
tools.description: Tool to describe a specific bulk import operation in Pinecone. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about an import's status, progress, timing, and any errors.

tools.name: Describe File
tools.description: Tool to get the status and metadata of a file uploaded to a Pinecone assistant. Use when you need to check file processing status, retrieve file metadata, or get a temporary signed URL for accessing the file contents.

tools.name: Describe Index
tools.description: Tool to retrieve full Pinecone index configuration including host and integrated embedding settings. Use when you need to check if an index has integrated inference (embed config) to avoid 'Integrated inference is not configured' errors by choosing the appropriate search method.

tools.name: Describe Index Stats
tools.description: Tool to get index statistics including vector count per namespace, dimensions, and fullness. Use when you need to understand the contents and status of an index.

tools.name: Describe Namespace
tools.description: Tool to describe a namespace in a serverless index, including the total number of vectors. Use when you need to get metadata about a namespace such as record count and indexed fields.

tools.name: Describe Restore Job
tools.description: Tool to get detailed information about a specific restore job in Pinecone. Use when you need to check the status, progress, or metadata of a restore operation.

tools.name: Generate Embeddings
tools.description: Tool to generate vector embeddings for input text using Pinecone's hosted embedding models. Use when you need to convert text into vector representations for semantic search or similarity matching.

tools.name: Fetch Vectors
tools.description: Tool to fetch vectors by ID from a Pinecone index. Use when you need to retrieve vector data and metadata for specific vector IDs from a single namespace.

tools.name: Get Assistant Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status and details of a Pinecone assistant. Use when you need to check assistant configuration, deployment status, or metadata.

tools.name: Get Model Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific model hosted by Pinecone. Use when you need to understand model capabilities for embedding and reranking operations.

tools.name: List Assistants
tools.description: Tool to list all assistants in a Pinecone project. Use when you need to retrieve all assistants with their configurations and status information.

tools.name: List Bulk Imports
tools.description: Tool to list all recent and ongoing bulk import operations in Pinecone. Use when you need to monitor or track the status of data import jobs. Supports pagination with a default limit of 100 imports per page.

tools.name: List Collections
tools.description: Tool to list all collections in a Pinecone project (pod-based indexes only). Use when you need to view available collections.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: Tool to list all files in a Pinecone assistant with optional metadata filtering. Use when you need to retrieve files uploaded to a specific assistant or filter files by metadata properties.

tools.name: List Index Backups
tools.description: Tool to list all backups for a specific Pinecone index. Use when you need to view available backups for an index. Supports pagination via limit and paginationToken parameters.

tools.name: List Indexes
tools.description: Tool to list all indexes in a Pinecone project. Use when you need to retrieve all indexes with their configurations and status information.

tools.name: List Available Models
tools.description: Tool to list all available embedding and reranking models hosted by Pinecone. Use when you need to discover available models or filter by model type (embed/rerank) or vector type (dense/sparse).

tools.name: List Namespaces
tools.description: Tool to list all namespaces in a serverless Pinecone index. Use when you need to discover available namespaces for data organization. Returns up to 100 namespaces by default with pagination support.

tools.name: List Project Backups
tools.description: Tool to list all backups for indexes in a Pinecone project. Use when you need to retrieve backup information across all project indexes. Supports pagination with limit and paginationToken parameters.

tools.name: List Restore Jobs
tools.description: Tool to list all restore jobs for a project with pagination support. Use when you need to view the status of restore operations or track restore progress.

tools.name: List Vectors
tools.description: Tool to list vector IDs in a Pinecone serverless index. Use when you need to browse or retrieve vector identifiers from a namespace. Supports filtering by prefix and pagination for large result sets.

tools.name: Query Vectors
tools.description: Tool to perform semantic search within a Pinecone index using a query vector. Retrieves IDs and similarity scores of the most similar items, ordered from most to least similar. Either vector or id parameter must be provided.

tools.name: Rerank Documents
tools.description: Tool to rerank documents by semantic relevance to a query. Use when you need to order retrieved documents by their semantic relevance to a user's search query using Pinecone's hosted reranking models.

tools.name: Retrieve Assistant Context
tools.description: Tool to retrieve context snippets from a Pinecone assistant for RAG or agentic workflows. Use when you need to fetch relevant document snippets based on a query or conversation messages to provide context for language model responses.

tools.name: Search Records in Namespace
tools.description: Tool to search records within a Pinecone namespace using text, vector, or ID query. Use when you need to find similar records based on embeddings or record IDs. Results can optionally be reranked for relevance.

tools.name: Start Bulk Import
tools.description: Tool to start an asynchronous bulk import of vectors from object storage (S3, GCS, or Azure Blob Storage) into a Pinecone index. Use when you need to import large volumes of vectors from external storage. Returns an import ID to track the operation status.

tools.name: Update Assistant
tools.description: Tool to update an assistant's instructions and configuration in Pinecone. Use when you need to modify an existing assistant's behavior by changing its instructions or metadata. Updates are applied immediately.

tools.name: Update Vector
tools.description: Tool to update a vector in Pinecone by ID. Use to overwrite vector values and/or metadata. Supports bulk updates via metadata filters.

tools.name: Upload File to Assistant
tools.description: Tool to upload a file to a Pinecone assistant for processing. Use when you need to add documents, PDFs, or other files to an assistant for knowledge retrieval or multimodal processing.

tools.name: Upsert Records to Namespace
tools.description: Tool to upsert text records into a Pinecone namespace. Use when you need to add or update records with automatic text-to-vector conversion.

tools.name: Upsert Vectors
tools.description: Tool to upsert vectors into a Pinecone namespace, overwriting existing vector IDs. Use when you need to add or update vectors with their dense and/or sparse values and metadata.
